note: Hotel and campground on SD-377 at the edge of Interior, a mile from the Badlands NP south-side entrance. Gravel RV sites up to 50 ft with picnic tables and fire rings, an extra-long row of 86-95 ft pull-throughs, primitive no-hookup RV sites, and tent areas on the outer edge; outdoor pool and grab-and-go breakfast. Formerly Badlands Interior Motel & Campground. --Claude
